summary: Bioceres Crop Solutions Corp. filed Form 6-K regarding Rizobacter's successful exchange offer and consent solicitation on May 29, 2026. The transaction covered Series IX and X Class A and B notes, with ~86% participation representing ~US$42.7 million aggregate principal. This liability management exercise extends maturities and reduces debt burden. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. The mechanics involve an exchange of existing notes for new securities. Watch for regulatory approvals and potential accounting impacts; risk-arb focuses on remaining noteholder consent and refinancing terms.
